question: Which closed events are tied for the highest ratio of total spending to total budget amount?
gold_sql: WITH ratios AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, CAST(SUM(b.spent) AS DECIMAL(20,4)) / NULLIF(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS ratio FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.status = 'Closed' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 0 ) SELECT event_name FROM ratios WHERE ratio = (SELECT MAX(ratio) FROM ratios)

expected.sql: WITH ratios AS ( SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, CAST(SUM(b.spent) AS DECIMAL(20,4)) / NULLIF(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS ratio FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.status = 'Closed' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name HAVING SUM(b.amount) > 0 ) SELECT event_name FROM ratios WHERE ratio = (SELECT MAX(ratio) FROM ratios)
